boundary: These are candidate human-survey datasets for future preregistered comparisons, not calibration results, panel grounding, or evidence that Likerts matches real respondents.
requiredProtocol: Record the exact question wording, response scale, population, geography, field dates, weights, exclusions, and dataset version.
Freeze the matching Likerts brief, source policy, locale, model routes, prompt version, and schema version before inspecting outcomes.
Transform scales with a declared mapping and report total variation distance, Jensen-Shannon divergence, maximum point spread, and subgroup coverage.
Publish every eligible comparison, including mismatches, failed runs, null results, and access limitations.

candidates.name: World Values Survey Wave 7
candidates.access: Official documentation and cross-national files; use is subject to the dataset's current terms and version notes.
candidates.calibrationUse: Cross-national values, trust, social attitudes, and demographic subgroup comparisons where wording and scale can be matched exactly.

candidates.name: European Social Survey
candidates.access: Freely accessible through the official ESS Data Portal; releases and corrections must be pinned by round and edition.
candidates.calibrationUse: European attitudes, trust, wellbeing, media use, identity, and demographic subgroup comparisons with documented survey weights.

candidates.name: OECD Trust Survey
candidates.access: Published indicators are available with reports; public-use microdata require an approved non-commercial academic or policy research request under OECD terms.
candidates.calibrationUse: Institutional trust and public-service satisfaction comparisons across participating countries when access and question alignment permit.

candidates.name: Pew Research Center public survey datasets
candidates.access: Many case-level datasets are free after creating an account and accepting the applicable terms; availability varies by study.
candidates.calibrationUse: Topic-specific national and cross-national opinion comparisons selected only after population, field date, wording, and scale matching.
